page_title: ACM 0-1 JUV | AC Milan v Juventus 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Maurizio Mariani has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Having seen unsporting behavior, Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Massimiliano Allegri (Juventus) is the recipient.
90+5' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

90+2' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable save to keep the ball from hitting the net. What a save!

90+2' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Antonio Mirante pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
90+1' 6 additional min. will be played.
86' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

86' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. Juventus get a corner.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.
84' Timothy Weah has picked up an injury and is replaced by Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
80' Foul! Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. AC Milan will take a free kick.
79' Substitution. Luka Romero (AC Milan) on for Tijjani Reijnders.
79' Davide Calabria will be replaced by Simon Kjaer (AC Milan).
78' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a change. Dean Huijsen (Juventus) replaces Federico Gatti.
78' Here comes a substitution. Arkadiusz Milik is given a rest as he is replaced by Federico Chiesa (Juventus).
77' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wojciech Szczesny, who smothers the ball.
75' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
75' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

74' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header, but sent the ball into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
74' A free kick to AC Milan.
73' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
73' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
72' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
71' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Federico Gatti (Juventus) for a tough tackle.
70' 6:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
69' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Adrien Rabiot (Juventus).
67' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Weston McKennie (Juventus), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
63' 0 - 1 Goal! Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) collected a pass and decided to try his luck from distance. The shot was deflected and it was enough to turn the ball past helpless Antonio Mirante. 0:1.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' Here is a change. Olivier Giroud is going off and Stefano Pioli gives the last tactical orders to Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
60' The substitution has been made. Rade Krunic (AC Milan) has replaced Yacine Adli.
60' Handball by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus). A free kick is awarded to AC Milan.
57' A cross from Timothy Weah (Juventus) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is behind the touchline and Juventus will take a throw-in.
56' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Moise Kean will be replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) comes onto the pitch so that Filip Kostic can be given a rest.
55' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is able to continue to play.
55' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
54' Timothy Weah (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
53' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AC Milan, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
52' Timothy Weah (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Maurizio Mariani and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' The free kick from long range, taken by AC Milan, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Filip Kostic (Juventus) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! AC Milan have a free kick.
50' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Juventus players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Timothy Weah (Juventus) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
45+2' What a great touch by Rafael Leao (AC Milan) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
45+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' Moise Kean (Juventus) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
43' Forced substitution due to red card. Pierre Kalulu joins the action as a substitute, replacing Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
40' We have witnessed a red card for Malick Thiaw (AC Milan).
40' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Malick Thiaw (AC Milan). Another situation results in a direct free kick for Juventus.
37' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.

34' Close! Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
32' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
31' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AC Milan.
26' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.

23' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Filip Kostic (Juventus) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
23' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.

23' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Maurizio Mariani no option but to blow his whistle. Juventus have a free kick.
22' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' Timothy Weah (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Juventus have a corner.
20' Moise Kean (Juventus) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
20' Moise Kean (Juventus) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
16' The resulting set piece from AC Milan is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

15' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) makes contact with a cross and strikes a shot towards the bottom right corner that lacks the power to find the back of the net, but the goalkeeper still has to pull off a marvellous diving save to keep his effort out. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
12' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Malick Thiaw (AC Milan). It's a free kick to Juventus, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
12' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
10' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
9' AC Milan hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Timothy Weah (Juventus) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

6' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
6' Referee Maurizio Mariani sees the trip by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.
4' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
3' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Neat passing move from AC Milan in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
Juventus will kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
